exports.name: NeshelAnimationsError
exports.description: Error thrown for invalid effect usage; identical on the server and the client (ADR 0009 §6).

exports.name: ReducedMotion
exports.description:
Reduced-motion policy (contracts/accessibility.md, constitution IV).

- `"user"` (default everywhere): follow `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- `"always"`: always use the reduced variant (e.g. an application-level "reduce motion" setting).
- `"never"`: ignore the preference. Reserved for motion essential to the meaning (WCAG 2.3.3);
  effects in this package never default to it.

exports.name: SpringOptions
exports.description:
Damped spring integrator (contracts/core-engine.md §2).

Pure and framework-agnostic: the caller owns the state object and the clock. Semi-implicit Euler
with fixed sub-steps (at most 1/240 s) keeps the integration stable for any frame rate; the
spring snaps to its target once both the distance and the speed fall below the rest thresholds,
so an idle effect stops scheduling frames.

props.name: damping
props.description: Damping coefficient c (default 26). `c >= 2 * sqrt(k * m)` never overshoots.

props.name: restDelta
props.description: Distance below which the spring may rest (default 0.01, in the value's unit).

props.name: restSpeed
props.description: Speed below which the spring may rest (default 0.01 units/s).

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring constant k (default 170). Higher is faster.
